end_date.description: Optional custom range end (Y-m-d). Only applied together with start_date.

name: resolve_account
title: Resolve Account By Login
description: Convert a customer-visible login number to the internal account_id. Call this FIRST when the customer mentions a login number and you need to use account_id with another tool.

name: search_knowledge
title: Search Knowledge Base
description:
Search the FundedNext KNOWLEDGE BASE (FAQ + business rules today, expanding). THE authoritative source for any RULE, POLICY, PROCESS, DEFINITION, RESTRICTION, ELIGIBILITY, TIMING, FEE, PRODUCT, or PENALTY question. Treat it as the foundation of essentially every answer — call it for nearly all questions, and ALWAYS in parallel with a dashboard tool on hybrid questions. Skipping it is only acceptable for a pure data lookup with zero rule/policy element.

MUST CALL search_knowledge when customer question contains any of these patterns:

- "Can I…", "Am I allowed…", "Is X permitted…", "What can I trade…"

- "What is…", "What does X mean…", "Explain X to me"

- "How does X work…", "How do I…", "What are the steps…"

- "How long does X take…", "When will X happen…", "What is the wait time…"

- "Why was X deducted…", "Why did X happen…", "What caused X…"

- "What's the difference between…", "Compare X and Y"

- "What happens if I…", "What's the penalty for…"

- "Restricted symbols", "news trading", "EA rule", "swing trade", "weekend hold", "consistency rule", "Quick Strike", "margin abuse", "drawdown type", "profit target"

- ANY question about plan rules, payout policy, KYC process, refund policy, account upgrade, breach consequences

HYBRID-QUESTION PATTERN — call IN PARALLEL with dashboard tool:

- "Am I close to breaching daily loss?" → get_account_overview + search_knowledge("daily loss limit rule")

- "Why was my payout deducted?" → get_payout_breakdown_data + search_knowledge("payout deduction rules")

- "Can I trade NFP news on my $100k Stellar?" → get_account_plan_info + search_knowledge("news trading rule Stellar")

- "Why did my account breach?" → get_rule_breach_history + search_knowledge("breach reason DLL")

PREREQUISITES: query — descriptive search phrase, not just one word. Better: "lifetime payout 95% addon rule" than "lifetime".

RETURNS: ranked array of FAQ chunks — each: { article_title, section_title, chunk_text, article_url, score }. Quote the chunk_text directly in your customer-facing answer; cite article_url when helpful.

CONFLICT RESOLUTION: If FAQ disagrees with dashboard data, FAQ wins on policy/rule questions, dashboard wins on customer-state questions (their numbers). Never invent a rule from dashboard data.

WHEN NOT TO USE — pure number questions:

- "What's my balance?" → get_account_overview only

- "How many trades?" → get_trading_overview only

- "Show me my trades" → get_trading_history only

query.description: Descriptive search phrase (2-8 words). Include domain terms (e.g. "payout deduction news trade rule") not single words.

name: record_ai_feedback
title: Record AI Conversation Feedback
description:
Store customer's open-ended feedback about the AI conversation. We are in BETA and use these comments to improve.

PRIMARY PURPOSE: capture the customer's words — what worked, what didn't, what they wish was different. Constructive comments are far more valuable than star ratings.

NEVER ASK FOR A RATING. Don't prompt "rate me 1-5". Instead invite open thoughts:

- "We're in beta — anything you'd like to share about this conversation?"

- "What could have been better here?"

- "Any thoughts on how this could be more useful?"

WHEN TO CALL — when customer volunteers feedback naturally:

- Customer types any opinion/critique/praise about the AI or the conversation

- Customer says something missing was unhelpful ("I wanted X but you gave Y")

- Customer answers your "anything to share?" invite with substantive text

- After successful complex multi-step help, customer says "thanks, this was helpful BECAUSE..." → capture the BECAUSE

WHEN NOT TO CALL:

- Customer just says "thanks" without elaboration (no constructive content)

- Mid-conversation (customer still asking other questions)

- For trivial single-fact lookups

- If customer ignores or declines your invite — do NOT push

PARAMETERS:

- comment (REQUIRED): customer's verbatim words about the AI experience. Max 2000 chars.

- rating (optional, 1-5): only set if customer's sentiment is clearly positive/negative. Leave NULL if neutral or ambiguous. Never prompt customer for a number.

SENTIMENT INFERENCE (use ONLY when obvious, otherwise omit rating):

- 1-2: "frustrating", "wrong", "useless", "doesn't work"

- 4-5: "amazing", "perfect", "exactly what I needed", "really helpful"

- Most cases → omit rating, store the comment alone

RETURNS: { recorded: true, thank_you_message } — relay thank_you_message naturally to the customer.

For negative-sentiment feedback: thank_you_message offers human escalation. Relay it.

comment.description: Customer's verbatim feedback comment (REQUIRED). The constructive content — what the customer actually said about the AI experience. Max 2000 chars.

rating.description: OPTIONAL — only set if sentiment is clearly positive (4-5) or negative (1-2). Omit if neutral/ambiguous. Never ask customer for a number.
